verdict.rationale: The x402 docs describe Agentic Wallets and agentic accounts that let an AI agent hold USDC and spend it on x402 services, which covers the core of provisioning a wallet the agent holds and spends from. The pack does not document how the user funds that wallet, what spending controls the owner keeps, or any balance view. Missing for 10: documented user funding flow, owner control/spending-limit mechanisms over the agent wallet, balance visibility, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can provision a wallet my agent holds and spends from — funded and controlled by me, with balance visibility

citations.quote: Agentic accounts let an AI agent hold funds and act through a Coinbase account or wallet. For an x402 buyer, the account is the source of USDC that the agent uses to pay for a service.
Give your own agent a wallet that can discover and pay for x402 services today.
buyers can pay from a CDP wallet or another signer
